title: Sidus Space Appoints Larry G. Swets Jr., CFA, to Board of Directors and Audit Committee Chair

body_markdown:
*Public Company CEO and Director of More Than a Dozen Listed Companies Brings Financial Oversight, Issuer-Side Capital Markets, and Governance Experience*


CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla.


, Oct. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Sidus Space, Inc.** (NASDAQ: SIDU) ("Sidus" or the "Company"), a vertically integrated space and defense technology company, today announced the appointment of Larry G. Swets Jr., CFA, to its Board of Directors as an independent director, effective October 5, 2026. Mr. Swets will chair the Board's Audit Committee, where his financial expertise will support oversight of the Company's financial reporting, internal controls, and risk management.


"Larry has sat in the CEO's seat through capital raises and transactions, and that is the perspective we want in the boardroom as we put the capital raised in the second quarter to work," said Carol Craig, Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Sidus Space. "We believe that his financial expertise and public company board experience strengthen the Board's oversight at an important stage for the Company."


Mr. Swets brings more than 25 years of experience in investment management, capital markets, and public company leadership. As chief executive officer of multiple listed companies, he has led capital raises, acquisitions, and business combinations from the issuer's side. He has also served as chief executive officer, chairman, or director of more than a dozen publicly traded companies listed on the Nasdaq, the New York Stock Exchange, and the Toronto Stock Exchange.


"My focus as Audit Committee Chair is on clear, accurate financial reporting and strong internal controls, and on helping the Board hold capital deployment to a high standard of discipline and accountability," said Mr. Swets. "Sidus has the capital and the in-house capabilities to execute its plan, and my role is to help make sure that execution is measured, reported, and governed well."


Mr. Swets currently serves as Chief Executive Officer of FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. (NASDAQ: FGII), Interim CEO of Saltire Capital Ltd (TSX: SLT. U) and as Head of Merchant Banking at FG Nexus Inc. (NASDAQ: FGNX). He previously served as Chief Executive Officer of FG Financial Group from 2020 to 2024, Kingsway Financial Services Inc. from 2010 to 2018, and GreenFirst Forest Products from 2016 to 2021.


Mr. Swets began his career at Lumbermens Mutual Casualty Company (Kemper Insurance) as Director of Investments and Fixed Income Portfolio Manager. He holds a B.A. from Valparaiso University and an M.S. in Finance from DePaul University, is a Chartered Financial Analyst, and is a member of the Young Presidents' Organization (YPO).


**About Sidus Space**


Sidus Space®, Inc. **(NASDAQ: SIDU)** is a vertically integrated space and defense technology company delivering satellite manufacturing and technology integration across all orbits, including LEO, GEO and lunar; all domain digital mission computing solutions; mission planning and management operations; AI enabling products and services; and space and defense hardware manufacturing. With its mission of Space Access Reimagined®, Sidus Space is committed to rapid innovation, adaptable solutions, and the optimization of space systems and data collection performance. With demonstrated space heritage, including designing, manufacturing and operating its own satellite and sensor system, LizzieSat®, Sidus Space serves government, defense, intelligence, and commercial customers around the globe. Strategically headquartered on Florida's Space Coast, Sidus Space operates a 35,000-square-foot space manufacturing, assembly, integration, and testing facility with direct access to nearby launch facilities.
